question: Ticket b3472c7ee794 says "bin/cmd/outline — a shortcut placed in the repo-root bin/ (D2: 'bin/cmd/outline is a thin registration...')", but outline 5.4.3.7 reads "Repo-root bin/ holds only the launcher itself, the one thing on PATH. Every shortcut lives in the bin/ of the device or machine it belongs to; its bin/ plus its bus verbs is what help lists at that level." (5.4.3.7 explicitly states 'Repo-root bin/ holds only the launcher itself, the one thing on PATH' and 'Every shortcut lives in the bin/ of the device or machine it belongs to'. The ticket violates this by placing a shortcut in repo-root bin/ instead of in outline_check machine's bin/.). Which stands, the ticket or the outline?
why_it_blocks: the ticket and the component outline disagree; building it would build one of them wrong
answer: The outline stands. The ticket now places the shortcut at cairn/devices/codemother/bin/outline ('cairn codemother outline'); repo-root bin/ is untouched.
